display_information.name: Omnigent Slack Bridge
display_information.description: Posts Omnigent agent alerts to per-session channels and routes your Slack replies back into the session.
display_information.long_description: A bridge that creates one Slack channel per Omnigent session, posts when an agent is blocked or a turn ends (mirroring the reply), and forwards your Slack replies back into the session as user messages via the Omnigent HTTP API.
